data.title: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory Faces Nasdaq Listing Compliance Review
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory ( (RMCF) ).

On November 24, 2026, Nasdaq notified Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory that its common stock had closed below the $1 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, creating a 180-calendar-day compliance period through May 24, 2027. The notice had no immediate effect on listing or trading; compliance required a closing bid price of at least $1 for 10 consecutive business days, while a further compliance period and potential delisting were conditional.

Also on November 24, 2026, the company amended Interim Chief Executive Officer Allen C. Harper’s offer letter, extending his original six-month service term by an additional six months while continuing his annual base salary of $140,000. Harper received a $130,000 RSU grant calculated using the 20-day volume-weighted average stock price before the grant date, with vesting in six equal monthly installments beginning January 8, 2027, subject to continued service as interim CEO.

data.title: Court Orders Searches and Asset Freezes Involving FASA in Grupo Fictor Case
data.description:
An announcement from Fictor Alimentos SA ( (BR:FASA3) ) is now available.

FASA S.A. is a publicly held company under judicial reorganization.

The São Paulo court partially granted a precautionary measure involving Grupo Fictor’s judicial reorganization, ordering civil searches and seizures at 12 addresses, including FASA’s registered office; the searches were carried out on November 26, 2026. It also ordered the sequestration, attachment and freezing of assets and financial assets belonging to FASA, its wholly owned subsidiary, controlling shareholder and Chief Executive Officer, up to R$4,295,549,149.70. The company is evaluating the decision’s effects on its activities and reorganization proceedings with legal advisers.

data.title: Jujubee Announces PLN 585,357.14 Inventory Impairment Write-Down
data.description:
Jujubee S.A. ( (PL:JJB) ) has shared an update.

Jujubee S.A. announced that its Management Board adopted a resolution on inventory impairment write-downs totaling PLN 585,357.14. The write-down covers 50% of the inventory value for “Realpolitiks 2” and 100% for the “Słowianie” prototype, “Emerald Caravan” and “Gore Doctor” on Nintendo Switch.

The write-down mainly reflects revenue generated to date, delays in releasing some games on other platforms, a lack of development of certain titles in 2026 and decisions not to develop them in subsequent years. It will be recognized as other operating expenses and affect the Company’s reported financial result and inventory value.

data.title: Akhan Reports November 27 Share Buy-Back
data.description:
Akhan Un Fabrikasi Ve Tarim Urunleri Gida Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:AKHAN) ) has provided an update.

Akhan Un Fabrikası ve Tarım Ürünleri Gıda Sanayi Ticaret A.Ş. is identified in the release as a food-industry company associated by name with flour and agricultural products. The release provides no further detail on its products or market focus.

Under a share buy-back program initiated by a Board resolution dated October 1, 2026, Akhan repurchased 131,500 B Group shares on November 27 at 21.840-22.200 TRY per share, with a weighted average price of 22.01 TRY; the repurchased shares represented 0.04811% of capital. The program lists 4,000,000 nominal TRY as the amount of shares to be acquired and a maximum payment of 100,000,000 TRY. The company said the buy-back was intended to address a share price it considers unreflective of operating performance, protect stakeholders and support the share price.

data.title: NevGold Announces TSX Graduation Following Final Approval
data.description:
Nevgold Corp ( (TSE:NAU) ) just unveiled an update.

NevGold is a mineral exploration and development company focused on discovering, de-risking and advancing gold and critical metals projects in Nevada and Idaho. Its portfolio includes 100% interests in Limousine Butte and Cedar Wash in Nevada, plus Nutmeg Mountain and Zeus in Idaho, targeting gold, antimony and copper.

NevGold announced final approval to graduate from the TSX Venture Exchange to the TSX, while retaining its “NAU” trading symbol and existing CUSIP and ISIN. The company also reconstituted its audit committee with three independent members and appointed Victor Bradley as lead independent director.

data.title: Sekuro Plastik Announces Investor Relations Changes
data.description:
Sekuro Plastik Ambalaj Sanayi A.S. ( (TR:SEKUR) ) has provided an update.

Sekuro Plastik Ambalaj Sanayi A.Ş. said a Nov. 27, 2026 board decision will end Zeynep Apaydın’s role as head of its Investor Relations Department and her related Corporate Governance Committee membership. The change is being made under Article 11 of the Capital Markets Board’s Corporate Governance Communiqué No. II-17.1.

Sema Baş will join the Investor Relations Department as a member effective Nov. 27, 2026. The board decision was unanimous among those attending the meeting.

data.title: Coast Copper Increases Proposed Non-Brokered Financing to $1.655 Million
data.description:
An announcement from Coast Copper Corp ( (TSE:COCO) ) is now available.

Coast Copper increased its non-brokered private placement to up to 4,137,500 flow-through units from 2,500,000, raising maximum gross proceeds from $1 million to $1.655 million at $0.40 per unit, citing strong investor demand. Each unit includes one flow-through common share and one warrant exercisable at $0.60 for 24 months after closing.

The proceeds are designated for eligible Canadian exploration expenses qualifying as flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures on the company’s British Columbia projects, with expenses to be incurred before December 31, 2027. The offering remains subject to customary conditions, including TSX Venture Exchange approval, and securities will carry a four-month-and-one-day statutory hold period.

data.title: Kalyon Güneş Reports Latest KLYPV Share Buyback
data.description:
An update from Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:KLYPV) ) is now available.

Kalyon Güneş Teknolojileri Üretim A.Ş. launched a share buyback program under a board resolution dated Oct. 19, 2026, covering TRY 5 million nominal value and a maximum payment of TRY 300 million. The stated purpose is to support healthy and stable share-price formation, protect shareholders’ interests and ensure the price reflects operational performance.

Under the program, the company repurchased 81,591 KLYPV Class B shares on Nov. 27, 2026, at an average price of TRY 47.194, within a TRY 46.30–47.70 range. Following buybacks conducted under the Dec. 9, 2025 board resolution, company-held shares reached TRY 5,519,724 nominal value, or 1.20% of share capital.

data.title: Orexo Reports Rights Issue Outcome
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Orexo AB ( (SE:ORX) ).

Orexo reported subscriptions for 218,750,000 new ordinary shares, representing approximately 69.2% of the 316,143,504 shares offered in its rights issue. At SEK 0.80 per share, the subscribed amount corresponds to approximately SEK 175 million before issue costs; DNB Bank subscribed for 88,638,814 shares under its underwriting commitment, utilized to SEK 70.9 million.

The release calculates approximately 86.2% dilution for shareholders who did not participate, excluding Orexo’s class C shares. Post-issue figures list 253,877,056 ordinary shares, up from 35,127,056, and a SEK 89.6 million increase in share capital.
